fact: A study of Ugandan public bodies found six MDAs (URA, UNMA, UIA, UETCL, UEDCL, KCCA) had integrated AI into service delivery, including URA customs risk profiling and an AI-based forecasting computer at UNMA launched in early 2022.
title: Artificial intelligence technologies usage for improved service delivery in Uganda
publisher: Africa's Public Service Delivery & Performance Review
